item.title: Chani
item.description: West Aussie Hip Hop femme fatale, Chani, is known for never pulling punches on topics of women’s empowerment. Chani pushes the boundaries of Hip Hop with hard-hitting lyrics and cheeky raw honesty, as she effortlessly blends a cocktail of Oz Hip Hop, Funk and Electro Pop influences, all in her trademark laid back style.
